summary: Event entity created by ecl::relation::RelationSystem::ProcessRelationChangeRequests (bg3.exe+0x19631A0, Toolkit EoCClient.dll+0x9E8C20): for every 4-byte key of two pending sets the system creates a new entity and adds this component (macOS: EntityCommandBuffer::AddComponentUnchecked<RelationChangedEventOneFrameComponent, unsigned int const&, bool>). The keys are the unsigned int keys of eoc::relation::RelationComponent's relation maps (HashMap<unsigned int, ERelation>, watched in SystemLoad). Born live in fights (faction/relation changes).

fields.name: RelationKey
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x1963E20 (8 bytes) stores the 4-byte key from the system's set at +0 (stride 4 in bg3.exe+0x19631A0); macOS AddComponentUnchecked<..., unsigned int const&, bool>. Live values like 0x0031002B / 0x01310103 - two 16-bit halves (likely a pair of faction indices). Same key type as RelationComponent's HashMap<unsigned int, ERelation>.

fields.name: field_4
fields.evidence: Second constructor argument (bool) at +4: 1 for keys of the first pending set (system +0x1B8), 0 for the second set (system +0x1E8). Which change kind each set is (e.g. permanent vs temporary) was not established. Live 0/1.

open_questions: Meaning of the bool (which of the two request sets).
Exact packing of the 32-bit relation key.
